params.name: PathOffset
params.title: 车道偏置左右校正(0)
params.descr:
(车道模式)
 (-)左侧 / (+)右侧
params.edescr: LaneMode only — (-)Left / (+)Right

params.name: LateralTorqueCustom
params.title: _LateralTorqueCustom(0)
params.descr:
使用自定义扭矩
 (开启以使用 TorqueAccelFactor, FrictionFactor)
params.edescr: Use Custom Torque(TorqueAccelFactor, FrictionFactor)

params.name: LateralTorqueAccelFactor
params.title: _LateralTorqueAccelFactor*0.001(2500)
params.descr:
值越低扭矩越强，但到某一点会变弱 
 使用最强点的值
params.edescr: As the value decreases, the torque becomes stronger up to a point, then weakens — Uses the value at the strongest point.

params.name: LateralTorqueFriction
params.title: _LateralTorqueFriction*0.001(100)
params.descr:
值越高微调量越多 

 推荐 0~50
params.edescr: More fine steering at higher values — 0-50 recommended

params.name: LateralTorqueKpV
params.title: _LateralTorqueKp*0.01(100)
params.descr:
转向比例系数(误差越大反应越强) 

 推荐 140
params.edescr: Steering Response Speed (Instant Reaction) — 140 Recommended

params.name: LateralTorqueKiV
params.title: _LateralTorqueKi*0.01(10)
params.descr:
转向累计误差校正 

 推荐 20
params.edescr: Steering Accumulated Error Correction — 20 Recommended

params.name: LateralTorqueKf
params.title: _LateralTorqueKf*0.01(100)
params.descr:
转向预测校正 

 推荐 85
params.edescr: Steering Feedforward Correction — 85 Recommended

params.name: LateralTorqueKd
params.title: _LateralTorqueKd*0.01(0)
params.descr:
转向微分系数(对抗急剧变化) 

 推荐 0
params.edescr: Steering Derivative Gain, 0 Recommended

params.name: LatMpcPathCost
params.title: *LATMPC.PathCost(200)
params.descr:
(车道模式) 路径跟随权重 
 越高则路径优先。
params.edescr: (LaneMode) Path Following Weight — Higher values prioritize the path

params.name: LatMpcMotionCost
params.title: *LATMPC.MotionCost(7)
params.descr: (车道模式) 航向权重
params.edescr: (LaneMode) Heading Weight

params.name: LatMpcAccelCost
params.title: *LATMPC.AccelCost(120)
params.descr:
(车道模式) 横向加速度限制 
 越低则敏捷性增加、稳定性降低
params.edescr: (LaneMode) Lateral Acceleration Limit — Lower values increase agility but reduce stability

params.name: LatMpcJerkCost
params.title: *LATMPC.JerkCost(4)
params.descr:
(车道模式) 越低则允许快速转向 
 平滑度降低
params.edescr: (LaneMode) Lower values allow quicker steering — reduces smoothness

params.name: LatMpcSteeringRateCost
params.title: *LATMPC.SteerRateCost(7)
params.descr:
(车道模式) 转向变化率限制 
 越低则转向更积极
params.edescr: (LaneMode) Steering Rate Limit — Lower values make steering more aggressive

params.name: LatMpcInputOffset
params.title: *LATMPC.InputOffset(4)
params.descr:
(车道模式) Mpc输入补偿 
 值越大进入弯道越早
params.edescr: (LaneMode) MPC Input Compensation — Higher values enter curves earlier

params.name: CustomSteerMax
params.title: _CustomSteerMax(0)
params.descr:
最大转向扭矩 
 在 270/384/409 中选择不产生错误的最大值
params.edescr: Maximum Steering Torque — Use the largest value among 270/384/409 that does not cause errors

params.name: CustomSteerDeltaUp
params.title: _CustomSteerDeltaUp(0)
params.descr:
(扭矩车辆) 
 越高则打方向盘速度越快
params.edescr: Torque Vehicle — Higher values increase steering wheel turn speed

params.name: CustomSteerDeltaDown
params.title: _CustomSteerDeltaDown(0)
params.descr:
(扭矩车辆) 
 越高则回正方向盘速度越快
params.edescr: Torque Vehicle — Higher values increase steering wheel release speed

params.name: CustomSteerDeltaUpLC
params.title: _CustomSteerDeltaUpLC(0)
params.descr:
(扭矩车辆) 
 变道时临时应用 SteerDeltaUp
params.edescr: Torque Vehicle — Temporarily applies SteerDeltaUp during lane changes

params.name: CustomSteerDeltaDownLC
params.title: _CustomSteerDeltaDownLC(0)
params.descr:
(扭矩车辆) 
 变道时临时应用 SteerDeltaDown
params.edescr: Torque Vehicle — Temporarily applies SteerDeltaDown during lane changes

params.name: SteerActuatorDelay
params.title: SteerActuatorDelay(30)
params.descr:
转向延迟值

params.name: LatSmoothSec
params.title: LatSmoothSec(13)x0.01

转向过滤值

params.descr:
设置胡萝卜巡航减速度

params.edescr: Carrot Cruise Deceleration Setting, -1: Cruise OFF

params.name: CarrotCruiseAtcDecel
params.title: 胡萝卜巡航ATC减速度x0.01(-1)
params.descr:
设置胡萝卜巡航 ATC 减速度
 -1: 不更改
params.edescr: Carrot Cruise ATC Deceleration Setting, -1: Not Change

params.name: CommaLongAcc

转向比 (参考车辆规格)

LiveSteerRatio 반영비율
